meta.title: iz — Stay Hidden
meta.description: End-to-end encrypted messaging, groups and communities platform.

landing.hero_desc: Messages encrypted with Signal protocol, group chats, communities and voice/video calls — the server sees nothing.

signal.title: Signal Protocol
signal.desc: X3DH key exchange and Double Ratchet ensure every message is uniquely encrypted.

instant.title: Instant Messaging
instant.desc: Real-time messages via WebSocket. Server never sees the content.

groups.title: Encrypted Groups
groups.desc: Efficient group messaging with Sender Keys for up to 5,000 members.

communities.title: Communities
communities.desc: Communities up to 500,000 members, feeds and subgroups.

calls.title: Voice/Video Calls
calls.desc: P2P calls via WebRTC. Audio and video do not pass through the server.

blind.title: Blind Server
blind.desc: We can never access your message content — by design.

login.title: Welcome Back
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue to iz.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backup_menu_desc: Securely back up your chats to the cloud or restore them
settings.backup_desc: Since your chat history is end-to-end encrypted, our servers do not store plaintext messages. You can securely back up your Signal protocol keys and restore them on a new device.
settings.backup_password_desc: This password will be used to encrypt your backup end-to-end. If you forget your password, you cannot recover your data.
settings.restore_password_desc: Please enter the password you used when creating the backup.
settings.restore_success: Backup restored successfully. Please refresh the page.
